description: On a runner with Docker: a host whose containers match its reviewed list is healthy; a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row is counted in the status, named by container name and short id in the diagnostic, alerts only when usrUnlistedAction is Alert, and the label never reaches the output; when docker ps fails but docker info answers (a shim on PATH) the check says it could not run and alerts. A host without Docker is Tier 2.

steps.label: One running container on a reviewed list
steps.run: set -e; d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/bin; cp /bin/sleep $d/bin/; for l in $(ldd /bin/sleep | grep -oE '/[^ ]+'); do mkdir -p $d$(dirname $l); cp $l $d$l; done; tar -C $d -c . | docker import - tc-test-sleep:1 >/dev/null; docker run -d --name tc-plain tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; mkdir -p /etc/tc-docker; echo name:tc-plain > /etc/tc-docker/expected-containers; echo 'tc-test review' > /etc/tc-docker/reviewed; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Hostile label: a running container whose Compose project label carries a forged row
steps.run: set -e; INJ=$'x\nstopped-old\t/zz\t\t\t\tfalse\tfalse\tno\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\t'; docker run -d --name innocent --label "com.docker.compose.project=$INJ" tc-test-sleep:1 /bin/sleep 3600 >/dev/null; docker ps --format '{{.Names}}'

steps.label: Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Warn (default): counted in the status, exit 0
outputContains: STATUS=1 expected: 1 running; 1 with unreadable Compose labels

steps.label: Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Alert: alerts, and the diagnostic names it
Hostile label, usrUnlistedAction Ignore: still counted, no alert
Failing Docker: a docker shim that fails docker ps
steps.run: real=$(command -v docker); test "$real" != /usr/local/sbin/docker || exit 1; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh' '# tc-test shim: Docker answers everything except docker ps' '[ "$1" = ps ] && { echo "Error response from daemon: tc-test simulated failure" >&2; exit 1; }' "exec $real \"\$@\"" > /usr/local/sbin/docker; chmod 755 /usr/local/sbin/docker; hash -r; docker ps; echo "docker ps exit $?"; docker info --format 'docker info still answers: {{.ServerVersion}}'

steps.label: Failing Docker: the check says it could not run, and alerts
outputContains: STATUS=Check could not run: Docker did not return its container list

steps.label: Failing Docker: remove the shim
steps.run: rm -f /usr/local/sbin/docker && docker ps >/dev/null && echo 'docker ps answers again'

steps.label: Docker answers again: back to the status with the unreadable count
Host without Docker says so and is healthy
